properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.3 declared in the committed lockfiles (e.g. nft package-lock.json:2535, inside the browserify-aes/browserify-cipher dependency tree). The package implements OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey: a single-iteration MD5-based KDF for deriving cipher keys from passwords — weak by modern standards (pbkdf2/scrypt/argon2 supersede it). Dependency inventory: shipped in the crypto-browserify stack; the tutorial application does not invoke it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (nacl.secretbox/box) as provided by tweetnacl@1.0.3, declared in the committed package-lock.json of the NFT Hardhat project. The AE scheme is available in the shipped library; the tutorial code does not call it directly. Note: Poly1305 MAC is quantum-safe, XSalsa20 is a symmetric stream cipher — Grover only halves its 256-bit key, so rating A+ is reasonable.
